# langsmith_relay (Resource)

Manages an organization LangSmith relay, which sends sandbox traffic for chosen hosts out through your network. Run the connector with `langsmith relay connect <id>`. Import with `<id>`; personal connections are rejected.

Private network connections must be enabled for the organization, and the API key needs `organization:infrastructure:manage`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A relay sends sandbox traffic for chosen hosts out through a connector on
# your network. Run the connector with `langsmith relay connect <id>`, and put
# the ID in sandbox proxy relay rules (`relay_id`).
resource "langsmith_relay" "ci_tailnet" {
  name        = "ci-tailnet"
  description = "CI sandbox egress to tailnet services"
}

output "ci_tailnet_relay_id" {
  value = langsmith_relay.ci_tailnet.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Connection name, unique among the organization's tunnels and relays. Renaming updates in place.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the connection accepts traffic. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Relay ID; pass it to `langsmith relay connect` and to sandbox proxy relay rules (`relay_id`).
- `status` (String) Connector status reported by LangSmith: `pending`, `active` or `inactive`.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import langsmith_relay.example relay_id
```
